name: Thalamus v4
description: Routes each model call, ranks the assistant's skills, recipes and plugins for each task, and records what it would have done. Loads by default. Mode shadow by default; it computes and records and changes nothing; only enforce hands the agent a short list.

mode.description: off = load nothing and open nothing; shadow = compute and record the per-call decision and the short list, change nothing; enforce = hand the agent the short list.

enabled.description: Ask Jev at all. Off: every read comes from local rules. With no token, nothing is asked whatever this says.

sendRealSituations.description: Real conversations may go to Jev. Synthetic cases always may.

tokenHelpUrl.description: Where to get a Jev token. Shown in the start line and the status; no default.

confidenceFloor.description: Below this Jev confidence an answer is unsure and the cautious option is taken.

privateSources.description: Sources whose content goes only to approved providers, and never to Jev unless approved below.

table.description: Vendor by topic class: allow or deny.

budgetMs.description: How long the prompt waits for the short list before going without it (ms). Was 800 until 2026-10-06; the ledger now records why a list was local, so the value can be chosen from counts.

rank.description: Build the short list from one ranked result per task (recall, then Jev's USE and INSPIRE split) that Broca's matcher reads too. Off: the old flat read of every card.

retentionDays.description: Decisions older than this are pruned.

digest.description: Enforce only: a reader condenses long text tool results, the raw result kept on disk under a name.

check.description: Enforce only: a model of another family checks a run that commits to something or claims a fact before it finishes.

finish.description: Enforce only: one writer puts the words the user reads of a run that several models worked on.

workerAgents.description: Enforce only, Claude Code lane: hand the bridge worker --agents sub-agents from the plugin.

workerModel.description: Enforce only, Claude Code lane: let the plugin set the worker's model per turn.

perCall.description: Enforce only: the embedded lane replaces the model per call. The call seam only observes today, so this records the owner's decision and acts when the seam can replace a model.

midThread.description: Enforce only: a running thread may be switched at all. Off: only fresh points (a new unit, a check, a finish, a digest) switch.

hedge.description: Enforce only: a second copy of a slow critical-path unit on another provider; the first answer wins. Shadow records the hedge it would send and sends nothing.

orchestrateAuto.description: Enforce only: model "auto" in an orchestrate script resolves to a routed claude-code model instead of the default leaf model.

ownModelChoices.description: Enforce only: Thalamus picks every model that used to be fixed (a leaf with no model, a sub-agent spawned with no model, the Claude roles of a round-table), each keeping its fixed model as the fallback. A model named on purpose is never replaced.

shortlist.description: Enforce only: hand the agent the enhancement short list on every prompt and answer the Claude Code hook route with it. Off: enforce routes but injects no list, as shadow does.

providerCaps.description: Concurrent calls per provider, so a fan-out never queues behind itself.

margin.description: A copy starts when a critical-path unit has run this multiple of its usual time.

allowedLeafProviders.description: Providers model "auto" may pick from in an orchestrate script. Widening it changes billing exposure, so it is the owner's.

enabled.description: The nightly run may write its estimates, rung times and card versions. A dry run never writes.

apply.description: The router uses the learned estimates in place of the public map alone.

explore.description: Overnight jobs, at most five per cent of their calls, try an option the router would not normally take.

shuffle.description: Enforce only: overnight short lists are shown in a shuffled order so the loop can measure how much the agent follows position.

replayMaxChars.description: Characters of a redacted task kept for replay.
